findings.text: Zero leads across all 28 days on $634.24 Google spend; 133 clicks arrived but 0 GA4 conversions recorded — conversion tracking is broken or landing page is not converting.
5 overdue SOW milestones (earliest Jul 20): Stripe QA, GHL gap closure, end-to-end stack re-test, paid landing pages, and UGC batch — all past due as of Aug 31.
3-day spend signal (Aug 31–Sep 2): $53.34, $12.86, $20.51 vs prior 3 days ($1.38, $6.86, $53.34) — erratic daily pacing averaging $28.90, with zero lead output across both windows.
GBP generated 49 actions (48 directions) in 28 days with 0 calls, yet paid Google drove 0 leads — organic intent exists but the paid funnel has no working conversion path.
GHL shows 125 opportunities created at $0 value and 0 won; 157 contacts with 0 appointments — pipeline populated by prior contacts, not current ad-driven leads.

suggestions.text: Audit Google Ads conversion tag and paid landing page immediately; $634.24 spent with 0 leads confirms a broken conversion path.
